## `get_project_pi`

*Available in [R](#get_project_pi-r)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function returns the PI Name or blank if none exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    get_project_pi()

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>
    *No arguments*
    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A character string with the PI name
